responsibility: Provides the D front-end target hooks for S/390, defining which builtin version identifiers the D compiler should expose for 31-bit versus 64-bit System z targets and hard-float versus soft-float configurations, and answering __traits(getTargetInfo, "floatAbi"). It is the D-language-specific adapter between the generic D front end and S/390 target properties.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/s390/s390-d.h, this file contains the executable D-front-end hook implementations for S/390, computing version identifiers and target-info strings from TARGET_64BIT and floating-point settings; the header only declares and binds those hooks.
